text: The five-file 566 delta is the exact inverse of 561, including the Fluent text and every changed consumer. Current unitPluralForm has been removed, so it is not a current helper to extend. The attempted event-duration-unit naming is historical evidence, not an accepted new rule. A landed change followed by a backout must be reconciled before its syntax enters the guide. Full deltas were read and the inverse comparison was performed; the review and failing test context remain pending.
title: Check the complete backout and newer source before recommending a style migration
